text: dsh-plugin-notify 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的会话状态通知插件，在 Host 监听会话停止、错误、用户提问和待审批事件，并通过浏览器事件流或可选的 WxPusher 推送送达通知。设置页可调整事件类型、浏览器提示音与显示行为、推送接收者及通知详情长度；还提供测试按钮检查通知通道。适合希望及时获知 DSH 会话进展的用户。浏览器通知无需外部账号；启用手机推送需配置 WxPusher appToken 和接收者，通知内容会发送至 WxPusher。

dsh-plugin-notify alerts users to DSH session stops, errors, questions, and approval requests through browser notifications or optional WxPusher. A settings page controls events, browser display, recipients, and notification detail. WxPusher requires an appToken and receives notification content.
想在 DSH 会话停止或出错时收到通知。
能否把 DSH 的提问和待审批提醒推到浏览器或手机？
Notify me when a DSH session stops, errors, or needs my input.
dsh-plugin-notify 的功能「会话事件提醒」：Host 监听会话停止、错误、用户提问及待审批状态，并按设置生成通知；停止事件可附会话标题和最近的模型回复。
dsh-plugin-notify 的功能「浏览器与 WxPusher 通知」：网页通过事件流接收通知并显示浏览器提示；启用推送后，Host 将通知发送到配置的 WxPusher 接收者。
dsh-plugin-notify 使用前须知：启用 WxPusher 后，通知正文、会话标题和会话标识摘要会发送到 wxpusher.zjiecode.com；需填写 appToken 与接收者。

dsh-plugin-notify README · dsh-plugin-notify：[中文](README.zh.md) | English

Session-state notifications for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH): a **WxPusher push** plus a **real browser notification** — with sound and `requireInteraction` — whenever a session stops, exits with an error, or asks you a question. Everything is configured from a native settings page (设置 → 通知 / Settings → Notifications).

dsh-plugin-notify README · dsh-plugin-notify：- **Two independent channels, one payload.** The Host detects the transition once and delivers the same content to WxPusher and to every open browser page.
- **Real system notifications.** `new Notification(...)` with a PNG icon, an optional WebAudio chime, and `requireInteraction` so the banner stays until you dismiss it.
- **Native settings page.** A `settings.section` page built from the plugin's own Config schema; every field is `volatile`, so edits apply **live** — no restart, no plugin remount.
- **Write-only secret.** The WxPusher `appToken` is declared `role('secret')`: it is stored in the profile, never returned over the wire, and edited through a path-addressed write.
- **Zero runtime dependencies beyond the schema library.** One Host file, one Client file, no build step.

dsh-plugin-notify README · What triggers a notification：| Event | Source | Detail shown |
|---|---|---|
| **Session stopped** | `api-session/status` → `running: false` | the folded session title + **the last model reply** (optional) |
| **Exited with an error** | `api-session/error`, `agent/error` | the error message |
| **Question asked** | `user-questions/request` (observed, then delegated) | the first question |
| **Approval needed** | `approval/request` (observed, then delegated) | the tool name |

dsh-plugin-notify README · What triggers a notification：The WxPusher body for the **stopped detail** (the last model reply) and the **question text** is never truncated and keeps its line breaks, so the phone shows the whole content; browser notifications still trim to `maxDetailChars` (an OS notification cannot fit long text anyway).

Two filters keep the noise down:

dsh-plugin-notify README · What triggers a notification：- **`minRunMs`** — a run shorter than this never reports a stop.
- **`stopDebounceMs`** — after the agent goes idle the Host waits this long; if the session starts running again the report is dropped. A stop is also suppressed when an error notification for the same session just fired, because that one is more precise.

dsh-plugin-notify README · What triggers a notification：`user-questions/request` and `approval/request` are Cordis **waterfalls**: this plugin only observes them and always delegates with `next()`, so it can never swallow a request meant for another answerer.

dsh-plugin-notify README · Requirements：- A DSH Host with the Web surface (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`), i.e. any normal `dsh web` profile. `ctx.webServer` is used for the notification stream; without it the plugin still pushes to WxPusher but delivers nothing to the browser.
- Node.js ≥ 20.
- A browser that supports the Notification API (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari 16+).
- A [WxPusher](https://wxpusher.zjiecode.com) account, only if you want phone pushes.
dsh-plugin-notify README · Install：> **A different project already owns `dsh-plugin-notify` on npm.** `pnpm add dsh-plugin-notify` installs that one, not this plugin — use the repository spec below.

dsh-plugin-notify README · Through the plugin manager (recommended)：Add a package to the Plugins page — this **repository spec**, or an absolute path to a checkout — and enable the bundle it adds:

```
github:This-is-XiaoDeng/dsh-plugin-notify
```

or, from a clone:

```
/path/to/dsh-plugin-notify
```

The CLI equivalent (writes the package into the profile's `dependencies` and `dsh.profile.bundles`):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:This-is-XiaoDeng/dsh-plugin-notify
```

dsh-plugin-notify README · Through the plugin manager (recommended)：The plugin's row is declared by the bundle's own `cordis.patch.yml`, so nothing else needs editing. If the profile was already running, reload it (or restart) so the new package enters the module-resolution table.

dsh-plugin-notify README · WxPusher credentials：1. Sign in at <https://wxpusher.zjiecode.com>, create an application, and copy its **appToken**.
2. Follow the app's QR code with WeChat to subscribe, then copy your **UID** from the app's user list (or use a **topic id** to reach many subscribers).
3. Paste the appToken and the UIDs into the settings page and press **Save**.

The appToken input is always empty on load — the Host only ever reports *whether* a token is set.

dsh-plugin-notify README · Browser permission：The page shows the current `Notification.permission`. If it is `default`, press **Request permission**; if it is `denied`, re-allow notifications for the page in your browser's site settings. Sound needs one user gesture on the page before the browser lets an `AudioContext` start — the plugin hooks the first click/keypress to unlock it.
dsh-plugin-notify README · Test：Each channel card owns its own test button, so a test never leaves you guessing which card it belongs to:

dsh-plugin-notify README · Test：| Card | Button | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| **Browser notifications** | *Send a test notification* | Broadcasts a frame to every connected page **and** pushes one WxPusher message — a full-stack probe. |
| **WxPusher push** | *Send a test push* | Pushes one WxPusher message only. It raises no system notification, and it works while `wxpusher.enabled` is still off, so credentials can be verified before switching the channel on. |

Each button reports its own outcome underneath:

dsh-plugin-notify README · Test：```
Browser: delivered to 1 page(s) · WxPusher: sent
WxPusher: no appToken
WxPusher: refused (appToken不正确)
Browser: no connected page (browser notifications may be off) · WxPusher: no UID or topic id

The buttons call the same endpoint with a `channel` selector — see below.

Host                                    Browser
────                                    ───────
api-session/status ─┐
api-session/error  ─┤

dsh-plugin-notify README · How it works：- The Host plugin registers two exact routes on `ctx.webServer`: the SSE stream at `/dsh-plugin-notify/events` and the test endpoint at `/dsh-plugin-notify/test`.
- The Client half opens an `EventSource` on the **document-relative** path `dsh-plugin-notify/events`, so it resolves under whatever mount served the page and inherits the page's own authentication. `EventSource` reconnects by itself; the Host sends a `: ping` heartbeat every 25 s.
- The settings page resolves its namespace from `ctx.configForms.describe()` — by entry id first, then by the schema it knows it owns — so it keeps working when a profile nests the bundle patch and prefixes the entry id.
- Writes go through `ConfigForm.mutate()` with **path-addressed** operations, so a secret that the wire never returned is never restated.

dsh-plugin-notify README · Endpoints：| Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/dsh-plugin-notify/events` | Server-Sent Events stream of notification frames. |
| `POST` | `/dsh-plugin-notify/test` | Probe the notification path. `?channel=browser` broadcasts without pushing, `?channel=wxpusher` pushes without broadcasting, and omitting it does both. Answers with `{ ok, channel, browser, wxpusher }`, where the channel that was not asked for reports `skipped`. |

dsh-plugin-notify README · Known limitations：- WxPusher content is composed in Chinese (the WxPusher audience is the phone); the browser notification is localized through the Harness locale service.
- The "stopped" signal is the agent going idle. A session that idles mid-conversation between turns is reported once, by design — `stopDebounceMs` and `minRunMs` are the knobs.
- Nothing is persisted beyond the profile config: no history, no replay of missed notifications.
- The plugin does not create a Remote namespace, so the browser half talks to the Host over the two HTTP routes above rather than over the typed Remote channel.
